Tuesday 1 September 2026 22:01, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Sky Bet Championship game between Swansea and Watford Swansea moved top of the Sky Bet Championship with a 2-0 home win over Watford. Adam Idah and Eom Ji-sung grabbed first-half goals as Swansea made it 10 points from four games, leapfrogging Charlton and Wolves to take over at the summit. It also meant Watford lost their unbeaten league record after beating Southampton and drawing against Wrexham and West Ham. Watford showed plenty of intent throughout but were unable to remedy the situation after a difficult opening half-hour in which Swansea oozed confidence and class. He is set to sign a six-year deal pending a medical. Monaco rejected a £38.5m (€45m) bid from Chelsea earlier on Deadline Day. messages.text: Capsey catches the eye during 'rogue' move to wicketkeeper

metadata.summary: A rogue move? One which brought an eye-catching one-handed catch, but is Alice Capsey's move to wicketkeeper harming her chance to be Nat Sciver-Brunt's natural successor?
metadata.content: Alice Capsey: England wicketkeeper impresses in first ODI win over Ireland after 'rogue' switch behind the stumps | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Alice Capsey: England wicketkeeper impresses in first ODI win over Ireland after 'rogue' switch behind the stumps Watch second ODI between England and Ireland in Derby on Thursday, live on Sky Sports Cricket from 12.30pm (1pm start) Tuesday 1 September 2026 21:22, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Alice Capsey takes a brilliant catch from behind the wicket to remove Alice Tector A rogue move? One which brought an eye-catching one-handed catch, but is Alice Capsey's move to wicketkeeper harming her chance to be Nat Sciver-Brunt's natural successor? England's call to have Capsey keep wicket for their one-day international series against Ireland divided opinion, despite her impressing with both bat and gloves in the opening six-wicket win in Leicester on Tuesday . Capsey claimed a terrific diving catch for the opening breakthrough and conceded only four byes - off a bizarre Issy Wong delivery that deflected off the stumps and to the boundary - before her unbeaten 41 off 40 balls saw England over the line. messages.text: Dual Gold Cup winner Galopin Des Champs dies aged 10

metadata.summary: Two-time Cheltenham Gold Cup hero Galopin Des Champs has died from injuries sustained in an accident in a field less than a week after being retired by connections.
metadata.content: Galopin Des Champs: Two-time Cheltenham Gold Cup winner dies aged 10 following accident in field | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Galopin Des Champs: Two-time Cheltenham Gold Cup winner dies aged 10 following accident in field The 2023 and 2024 winner of the Cheltenham Gold Cup, Galopin Des Champs has tragically died following an accident in a field; The 10-year-old horse, who was trained by Willie Mullins, was found with a severe injury on his near front leg. Tuesday 1 September 2026 18:38, UK Image: Galopin Des Champs has tragically died at the age of 10 Two-time Cheltenham Gold Cup hero Galopin Des Champs has died from injuries sustained in an accident in a field less than a week after being retired by connections. Ruby Walsh revealed the news late on Tuesday evening that the 10-year-old gelding had suffered an injury to his near front leg which vets concluded was irreparable. "Sadly Galopin Des Champs suffered an injury in his field this morning and could not be saved," Walsh said in a statement to Racing TV . "He was checked a few times throughout the morning but late in the morning when I went to get him for exercise I found him with a severe injury, high up on his near front leg. "He was attended to by our vets immediately but X-rays revealed extensive unrepairable damage."
